notice: Required behaviors for implementation tests. No application acceptance tests have been executed in this blueprint.

cases.when: Inspect tracked and untracked files before scaffolding.
cases.then: Preserve unrelated files; report actual tools and blockers.

cases.when: Load a native adapter and its referenced role/skills.
cases.then: Resolve real files; do not assume agents spawned or permissions enforced.

cases.when: Validate task and package dependencies.
cases.then: No unknown dependencies, cycles, or adapter imports in core.

cases.when: Exercise auth adapter, D1, Pages proxy and Worker using synthetic values.
cases.then: Record compatible versions and measured runtime results, not Node-only success.

cases.when: Force a later statement to fail.
cases.then: Prove rollback or choose documented commit-marker behavior before financial writes.

cases.when: Send authentication responses through Pages service binding.
cases.then: Preserve Set-Cookie and correct public origin; no private response caching.

cases.when: Process representative bounded synthetic receipt/PDF workloads.
cases.then: Record limits and supported path; do not claim Free-plan viability without evidence.

cases.when: Add EUR 0.10 and EUR 0.20 using domain values.
cases.then: Return exactly 30 minor units without binary-float money arithmetic.

cases.when: Parse EUR, JPY and KWD cases including excess decimals.
cases.then: Respect currency-specific digits; reject malformed/unsupported monetary values.

cases.when: Import an event near a month boundary in two user timezones.
cases.then: Apply explicit date basis and timezone consistently; preserve source dates.

cases.when: Aggregate more than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER in minor units.
cases.then: Return exact decimal-string totals or a controlled supported-bound error; never rounded numbers.

cases.when: Process an invoice due next month and a separately paid receipt.
cases.then: Only verified/user-confirmed payment enters spending.

cases.when: Receive missing total and an explicit EUR 0.00 receipt.
cases.then: Missing is review; zero is valid and distinct.

cases.when: Receive 2026-02-30 or an ambiguous 03/04/2026.
cases.then: Reject impossible date; review ambiguity rather than silently choosing a locale.

cases.when: Associate user A purchase with user B document.
cases.then: Database/application reject cross-tenant association.

cases.when: Insert the same tenant/provider/message/part twice concurrently.
cases.then: One document identity; no duplicate payment.

cases.when: Install clean database and upgrade previous fixture state.
cases.then: Preserve existing data/constraints and verify indexes.

cases.when: List, join, update and delete records with a hostile tenant parameter.
cases.then: All operations use trusted context and cannot read or alter other tenants.

cases.when: Call a protected API and background-status route unauthenticated.
cases.then: Return unauthorized without financial data.

cases.when: Log in with Google A, then authorize mailbox B.
cases.then: Keep workspace identity A and add verified mailbox B, not a new user.

cases.when: Reuse or change expired OAuth state or forge cross-origin mutation.
cases.then: Reject without changing connections or spending.

cases.when: Supply same displayed email from an unrelated identity flow.
cases.then: Never automatically merge identities based only on untrusted email text.

cases.when: Inspect production session lifecycle and logout.
cases.then: Secure HttpOnly cookie, valid SameSite behavior and invalidation; no tokens in localStorage.

cases.when: Persist mailbox refresh token and BYOK key.
cases.then: Only authenticated ciphertext stored; no secrets returned via settings/export/logs.

cases.when: Move encrypted token from user A connection into user B context.
cases.then: Decryption fails; no credential reuse.

cases.when: Read old-key ciphertext and rotate to active key.
cases.then: Controlled migration succeeds; retired key cannot encrypt new values.

cases.when: Two workers refresh credentials; provider omits new refresh token in one response.
cases.then: CAS protects newest state; missing token does not erase valid existing token.

cases.when: Deliver the same queue job twice in parallel.
cases.then: At most one committed financial result; both deliveries terminate safely.

cases.when: Expire and reassign a job while first worker finishes later.
cases.then: Old worker cannot commit any fenced write.

cases.when: Persist a ready job then simulate lost/expired queue message.
cases.then: Dispatcher reconstructs delivery from D1 without data payload persistence.

cases.when: Crash after financial write but before queue acknowledgement.
cases.then: Retry sees completed result and does not duplicate spending or archive.

cases.when: Disconnect mailbox while its extraction is running.
cases.then: Generation fence prevents new writes and future provider calls where cancellable.

cases.when: Backfill one large tenant while another has a fresh receipt.
cases.then: Bounded pages and per-tenant concurrency prevent starvation.

cases.when: Retry permanent malformed input repeatedly.
cases.then: One terminal issue; bounded attempts, no endless cost loop.

cases.when: Start import on a fixed date and paginate historical candidates.
cases.then: Use fixed calendar boundary and cutoff; resumable counts and coverage are truthful.

cases.when: Deliver a receipt while historical pagination is running.
cases.then: Capture/replay incremental changes without loss or duplicate payment.

cases.when: Return 404 for stored history cursor.
cases.then: Recover with bounded scan and visible coverage; do not discard existing records.

cases.when: Return invalid_grant after controlled refresh.
cases.then: Pause affected connection and request reconnect; retain ledger records.

cases.when: Return 429 with Retry-After during pagination.
cases.then: Respect delay, retain checkpoint, and continue other tenants.

cases.when: Connect two verified Gmail accounts to one workspace.
cases.then: Discover both independently; strong duplicate receipts count once.

cases.when: Delete source email after extraction with no archive.
cases.then: Preserve structured record and mark original unavailable, not a fabricated link.

cases.when: Place supported receipts outside Inbox and in an unfamiliar language.
cases.then: Scan configured folders/labels; disclose candidate-query gaps and allow bounded recovery scan.

cases.when: Provide nested MIME with HTML, text, inline logo and two invoices.
cases.then: Deduplicate body alternatives and process each real invoice separately.

cases.when: Parse a synthetic PDF with tax, subtotal and total.
cases.then: Choose actual paid total with numeric evidence; do not assume attachment bytes are plain text.

cases.when: Provide image-only or password-protected PDF.
cases.then: Use a verified capable path or Needs Review; never guessed OCR totals.

cases.when: Supply oversized or highly nested compressed content.
cases.then: Reject within bounded memory/CPU; no unbounded decompression or hidden raw storage.

cases.when: Render mail containing scripts, tracking pixels and remote CSS.
cases.then: Do not execute or fetch them; render only safe extracted fields.

cases.when: Hit text limit before final total.
cases.then: Mark incomplete/review instead of silently extracting subtotal.

cases.when: Return extra fields, fenced text, invalid amount or huge JSON.
cases.then: Reject boundedly; at most one repair, no unvalidated DB writes.

cases.when: Model returns a total not supported by input quote.
cases.then: Financial blocker; self-reported confidence cannot override evidence.

cases.when: Receipt requests exporting secrets and changing system instructions.
cases.then: No tool, URL fetch, key disclosure, or policy change.

cases.when: BYOK model times out while hosted model is available.
cases.then: No undisclosed fallback or second destination; show selected-provider failure.

cases.when: Two jobs reserve the last allowance simultaneously.
cases.then: Only authorized reservation proceeds; quota cannot be overspent by race.

cases.when: Provider may have processed timed-out request.
cases.then: Keep conservative usage state and bounded retry, not unlimited free retries.

cases.when: Choose localhost, metadata IP, embedded credentials or redirected AI endpoint.
cases.then: Reject destination; no arbitrary outbound proxy.

cases.when: Select text-only endpoint for native PDF input.
cases.then: Use verified converter or unsupported state; never invent provider file support.

cases.when: Process three messages for the same stable purchase reference.
cases.then: Keep all evidence, create one actual payment event.

cases.when: Process same merchant/amount/day with different purchase references.
cases.then: Keep distinct; weak similarity can suggest review only.

cases.when: Process EUR 100 order with two paid EUR 50 installments.
cases.then: Two distinct payment events total EUR 100; no third invoice-total entry.

cases.when: Receive corrected document using old invoice number with different total.
cases.then: Version/conflict review; no silent overwrite or extra payment.

cases.when: Receive refund request or credit note without cash completion.
cases.then: No negative cash entry.

cases.when: Process separate completed refunds against one purchase.
cases.then: Validate amounts/currency and unique events; net is correct without deleting original payment.

cases.when: Receive a monthly card statement plus individual receipts.
cases.then: Do not add statement total as another purchase.

cases.when: Two tenants upload identical receipt evidence.
cases.then: No cross-tenant linkage, retrieval, cache leak or shared financial state.

cases.when: Mix paid, unpaid, duplicate-blocked and missing-FX records.
cases.then: Summary equals eligible ledger entries and shows exclusions/coverage.

cases.when: New user starts backfill and closes browser.
cases.then: Work continues; returning UI shows actual progress, not false completion.

cases.when: Apply month/category/merchant filters and paginate equal-date records.
cases.then: List, summary and export agree; stable pagination does not skip ties.

cases.when: Navigate primary journey at 360px width without a mouse.
cases.then: Readable money, labeled inputs, visible focus and accessible status updates.

cases.when: User corrects category/amount then a source is reprocessed.
cases.then: Preserve explicit override and audit original extracted value.

cases.when: Two tabs edit the same purchase version.
cases.then: Second receives conflict rather than losing first change.

cases.when: User confirms an unpaid invoice was paid with date and amount.
cases.then: One user-confirmed event with distinct provenance; repeated request is idempotent.

cases.when: Merge records with overlapping evidence then reverse.
cases.then: Preserve provenance, total and unique ledger events.

cases.when: Resolve nonfinancial category warning but leave uncertain currency.
cases.then: Financial blocker remains; unrelated archive failure does not hide valid spending.

cases.when: Export merchant beginning with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return.
cases.then: Text cannot become an executable spreadsheet formula; money fields remain correctly typed.

cases.when: Request another user’s data/export with guessed ID.
cases.then: No cross-tenant response or archive link.

cases.when: Delete account while jobs are queued/running.
cases.then: Invalidate session, fence jobs, erase active records/keys within stated target.

cases.when: Disconnect one mailbox with shared purchase evidence.
cases.then: Stop sync/remove credentials, keep records unless separately confirmed for deletion.

cases.when: Delete data from one of two inboxes supporting the same purchase.
cases.then: Preview accurate effects and retain independently supported evidence.

cases.when: Inspect D1, queue payloads, logs and export after processing.
cases.then: No raw bodies/PDFs/evidence quotes/model transcripts or secrets.

cases.when: Connect supported Outlook.com and organizational accounts.
cases.then: Use delegated read access; display tenant/admin-policy errors truthfully.

cases.when: Put receipts in nested, archive and moved folders.
cases.then: Maintain folder-specific state; not Inbox-only while claiming full mailbox.

cases.when: Return nextLink/deltaLink with encoded tokens.
cases.then: Follow trusted provider URL intact; never concatenate or invent delta tokens.

cases.when: Move message between supported folders during sync.
cases.then: Request immutable IDs consistently and avoid duplicate documents.

cases.when: Expire a folder delta token.
cases.then: Recover that folder safely with coverage warning and no cursor loss.

cases.when: Use app without Drive then connect a different Google account.
cases.then: App works without raw archive; independent storage consent ties correct account.

cases.when: Create receipts folder and upload PDF/.eml.
cases.then: Use drive.file; never require whole-drive read access.

cases.when: Upload succeeds but response is lost; retry.
cases.then: Reuse saved pre-generated ID and verify existing file; no duplicate original.

cases.when: Hit full quota, revoked permission or deleted folder.
cases.then: Preserve ledger; report archive failure and controlled recovery.

cases.when: Enable archiving for old records whose email may be deleted.
cases.then: Explicit bounded backfill; truthful missing-original status.

cases.when: Delete service account while invoices exist in user Drive.
cases.then: Leave user-owned files by default and disclose this behavior.

cases.when: Value weekend receipt with latest eligible prior rate.
cases.then: Persist source/date/exact rate; do not use a later rate.

cases.when: Receive unsupported currency or too-old prior rate.
cases.then: Show original amount and missing conversion; never default rate to 1.

cases.when: Convert two EUR-equivalent half-minor-unit entries.
cases.then: Round each then sum, consistent with displayed rows.

cases.when: Refund a January purchase in February at February FX.
cases.then: February net reflects refund date/rate; January payment remains.

cases.when: Change preference during valuation jobs.
cases.then: Preserve original amounts; version valuations and show pending coverage.

cases.when: Receive three same-service monthly payments with anchored dates.
cases.then: Suggest a series; forecast does not create ledger payments.

cases.when: Start on January 31 with February then March occurrence.
cases.then: Clamp February but restore original anchor in March.

cases.when: Receipt explicitly states annual subscription with charge.
cases.then: Suggest annual cadence with transparent evidence, not annual deduction from one ambiguous purchase.

cases.when: Compare variable usage bills and fixed-plan price change.
cases.then: Do not label every variation a subscription price increase; require reviewable evidence.

cases.when: Dismiss or mark series canceled then resync receipts.
cases.then: Preserve user decision and historical spending; no external cancellation request.

cases.when: Run labeled challenge and held-out receipt sets.
cases.then: Report denominators, errors and coverage; no fabricated accuracy or tests.

cases.when: Scan build, logs, traces, CI artifacts and exported settings.
cases.then: No customer content, credentials or production tokens.

cases.when: Restore an older snapshot containing a deleted account.
cases.then: Reapply independent tombstones and invalidate stale auth before serving.

cases.when: Audit keyboard, forms, charts, contrast and screen-reader labels.
cases.then: Meet documented AA target checks; do not claim certification from automated scans.

cases.when: Exercise same build on approved staging with provider test identities.
cases.then: Record actual connection/sync/archive/export paths and limitations.

cases.when: Attempt unrestricted signup without provider/privacy/security approvals.
cases.then: Remain allowlisted; no code flag silently bypasses release approval.

cases.when: Process EUR 100 total, EUR 70 card payment and EUR 30 redeemed store credit.
cases.then: Keep EUR 100 purchase detail and one EUR 70 cash-spending entry; ambiguous splits remain in review.

cases.given: Proposed public copy and dated findings
cases.when: Review all headlines and comparative/privacy claims.
cases.then: Lead purchase records; do not claim unique free service, complete spend, guaranteed savings, unverified security or proven market fit.

cases.when: Open landing, login and navigation.
cases.then: Only live-enabled capabilities have active CTAs; future features/examples are labeled, not presented as available.

cases.given: Public-config response with private operator settings nearby
cases.when: Fetch public JSON unauthenticated.
cases.then: Only whitelisted labels/flags/policy paths appear; no keys, key references, tenant values, budget reserves or diagnostics.

cases.given: No final brand, prices, or testimonials selected
cases.when: Review new copy and config.
cases.then: Keep configurable working name; do not invent commercial decisions, quotes, customer counts, or a permanent free promise.

cases.given: Unauthenticated browser and disabled live AI
cases.when: Visit /demo and inspect a synthetic purchase.
cases.then: Usable labeled example; no login, provider calls, model use, private API reads, queues or database writes.

cases.given: Signed-in user has private records cached
cases.when: Open /demo then sign out/switch user.
cases.then: Demo never reads private cache/loaders; no private record in example or another user session; clear appropriate query data.

cases.when: Render purchase lifecycle and period summary.
cases.then: Headphones net is EUR 90; summary net EUR 120; unpaid EUR 80 excluded; two EUR 15 purchases remain distinct.

cases.when: Attempt edit, export, sync, archive or source navigation.
cases.then: Read-only controls cannot invoke live mutations; synthetic evidence stays local and clearly labeled; no demo records enter real account/export.

cases.when: Complete identity authorization.
cases.then: Only identity scopes requested; login does not create a mailbox connection or request Drive; no company, card, bank, or AI-key gate.

cases.when: Complete token/identity/scope verification.
cases.then: Store awaiting_import connection, no message listing/body fetch/parser/model call or auto-sync; redirect to account review.

cases.when: Read explanation then start OAuth.
cases.then: Explain mailbox-wide read permission and app purchase filtering before provider prompt; cannot claim receipt-only technical access.

cases.given: Login account A, mailbox selected B
cases.when: Return from OAuth and change wrong mailbox before Start.
cases.then: Show actual B; login remains A; no B content scanned before explicit Start and no accidental workspace switch.

cases.when: Cancel or deny requested scope.
cases.then: Session remains; accurate no-connection/partial-scope state; retry only on explicit action, no infinite OAuth loop.

cases.given: Approved hosted provider and known user allowance
cases.when: Open review/start.
cases.then: Show real destinations, remaining allowance, historical consumption, actual date range/currency/timezone and hourly behavior before acceptance.

cases.given: Same account, range and review revision
cases.when: Double-click Start and send from two tabs.
cases.then: Single durable parent import and authorized schedule; replay returns same run or documented conflict; no extra billed extraction.

cases.given: No Drive connection or BYOK key
cases.when: Complete normal hosted path.
cases.then: Can reach real records without archive/key/company/setup survey; processor identity still visible; optional choices are not silently enabled.

cases.given: Review card refers to an old disclosure or destination
cases.when: Submit Start after configuration changes.
cases.then: Reject with PROCESSING_REVIEW_REQUIRED; show updated details and require acceptance; no request to the new unapproved recipient.

cases.given: Hosted AI/parser disabled and no approved BYOK route
cases.when: Attempt new import/extraction.
cases.then: Return accurate unavailable state and preserve example/existing records; never fabricate provider or silently fall back.

cases.when: Refresh, use Back, close and reopen on another device.
cases.then: Resume server-owned run and preferences; no duplicate job; history continues without browser; no forced new wizard.

cases.given: One importing mailbox and available second slot
cases.when: Add another inbox.
cases.then: Independent verified connection and explicit review; original import/session unaffected; reached limits explained without fake billing.

cases.given: Connected mailbox still awaiting explicit Start
cases.when: Cron or forged manual sync request runs.
cases.then: No content jobs dispatched; return safe review-required state; connection authorization is not processing authorization.

cases.given: Live budget exhausted after some history
cases.when: Observe progress, then open records.
cases.then: Show paused reason, retained records and available recovery; no upgrade checkout or implied free-unlimited processing.

cases.given: Provider grants identity but not required mail scope
cases.when: Return callback and attempt content fetch.
cases.then: Related feature disabled, missing permission explained; no content request or success label for an unreadable connection.

cases.when: Create recent/older slices across calendar and DST boundaries.
cases.then: Disjoint half-open slices exactly cover requested interval; recent last 30 calendar days is ordering only; no boundary loss.

cases.when: Plan import.
cases.then: Recent range clamps to start; omit empty older slice; no expansion beyond user-selected dates.

cases.given: Provider returns candidate pages in nonchronological order
cases.when: Run recent-first discovery.
cases.then: Use date-bounded recent slice rather than trusting order; schedule discovered recent extraction without waiting for full history.

cases.when: Replay concurrent discoveries.
cases.then: Shared source/business dedupe and independent cursors avoid duplicate entries or missed new messages.

cases.given: One accepted purchase and unfinished older jobs
cases.when: Open progress then select View purchase records.
cases.then: Record visible immediately; chosen history continues; page transition does not cancel queued work.

cases.given: Recent slice complete and older processing unfinished
cases.when: Read parent state.
cases.then: Parent not complete; counter concepts remain distinct; no false fully-imported flag or all-receipts-found assertion.

cases.when: Render progress and periodic updates.
cases.then: Show stage and accurate distinct counts; no fabricated percentage, ETA or progress based on total inbox size.

cases.given: No recent records but older slice pending
cases.when: Render empty state.
cases.then: Say no recent matches yet; continue older scan; do not claim no purchases or zero spending.

cases.given: Worker crash after durable discovery but before queue acknowledgment
cases.when: Resume/replay slices.
cases.then: Saved cursor/job boundaries retain work and avoid duplicate purchase counts; browser is irrelevant to recovery.

cases.when: Measure start-to-first-record and first-user-action separately.
cases.then: Record actual times, sample size, failures/pauses and limits; five minutes is an internal target, never fabricated achieved SLA.

cases.given: Ready purchases with partially imported history
cases.when: Open Home at mobile and desktop sizes.
cases.then: Search, coverage and recent records lead; charts secondary; useful next action only when supported by real data.

cases.given: Order, invoice, payment EUR 120, pending/completed partial refund EUR 30
cases.when: Render evidence timeline before and after completion evidence.
cases.then: One purchase; paid EUR 120; pending refund not netted; completed refund nets to EUR 90; each event has source/provenance.

cases.when: Open Home and details.
cases.then: Show records and specific uncertainty; no payment-inflated summary or misleading empty/zero-spend claim.

cases.given: Old purchase payment and current-month refund
cases.when: Filter Home to current month then open lifecycle.
cases.then: Month shows only current event effects; lifecycle explicitly includes older payment; summary/list/export date semantics agree.

cases.given: One missing field and valid remaining evidence
cases.when: Open Needs attention.
cases.then: Ask the exact question needed; avoid compulsory full re-entry; uncertain new entry excluded without hiding unrelated valid payments.

cases.when: Open purchase evidence actions.
cases.then: Keep structured record; show Original unavailable and reason; no falsely successful archive badge or broken download CTA.

cases.given: 360 CSS px, zoom/reflow and keyboard-only input
cases.when: Complete example/sign-in/connect/review/start/results path.
cases.then: No critical horizontal scrolling/clipped values; controls labeled; privacy and destination visible; focus order and errors work.

cases.given: User reading progress while background records arrive
cases.when: Poll status and complete first extraction.
cases.then: No forced redirect/focus theft; polite milestone announcements, no per-message alert flood; View records offered.

cases.given: Archive feature available and first real purchase opened
cases.when: Show optional archive prompt, dismiss, or connect from Settings earlier.
cases.then: At most one dismissible prompt; no gate; no repeated nag on every route; actual separate account/folder displayed.

cases.given: Drive denied/full/disconnected or later account deletion
cases.when: Continue extraction and inspect archive state.
cases.then: Financial records unaffected; actual upload needed for saved badge; existing user-owned Drive files remain by default.

cases.given: Two comparable service bills and tax/currency/usage variants
cases.when: Compute display change evidence.
cases.then: Link actual source pair; only comparable basis supports strong price-change claim; others labeled uncertain, no FX-only alert.

cases.given: Receipt-based recurring suggestion with no usage data
cases.when: Render series and next date.
cases.then: Do not claim unused service or guaranteed savings; projected date clearly estimated unless documented terms support it.

cases.when: Set Work manually and reprocess source.
cases.then: Tag survives; no automatic tax/income/profile inference; payment eligibility unchanged.

cases.given: Mixed manual tags and cross-inbox evidence
cases.when: Filter list, summary and CSV/JSON export.
cases.then: Same tag/date/ledger inclusion semantics and unique events; unassigned records preserved; no team/accounting structures.

cases.given: Operator measurement off or user has not opted in
cases.when: Complete product flow.
cases.then: No optional product events stored; features fully work; technical import timestamps not mislabeled as user activation.

cases.when: Attempt arbitrary/private payload, cross-tenant access or high-volume duplicates.
cases.then: Only allowlisted fields/events and authorized bounded actions accepted; caps/dedupe enforced; no receipt IDs/amounts/search terms in event rows.

cases.given: Demo visitor, background sync, or passive polling
cases.when: Run actions that resemble activity.
cases.then: No real-product activation event; demo never counts; only explicit authorized evidence-open intent is measured.

cases.when: Opt out, exceed retention, or delete account.
cases.then: Purge relevant events, stop future collection and retain full product access on opt-out; no delayed event resurrection.

cases.given: Explicit owned evidence-open action returns a safe external link
cases.when: Record optional activation proxy.
cases.then: Record intent only, once; do not assert external receipt was loaded/read or that money was saved.

cases.given: No competitor trial or pilot executed
cases.when: Prepare validation report.
cases.then: Worksheet remains marked not run with empty results; no invented participants/retention/accuracy or market-fit claims.
